Welcome to the National Museum of American History!
The museum’s world class collection of over 1.7 million objects helps tell the complex history of our nation.
The museum is open every day, except December 25, from 10:00 a.m. to 5:30 p.m.
Admission is free and no tickets are required.
Wegmans Wonderplace is open Wednesday–Sunday from 10 a.m.–4 p.m.; closed Monday–Tuesday.
Draper Spark!Lab is open Wednesday–Sunday from 10 a.m.–4 p.m.; closed Monday–Tuesday.Spark!Lab will be closed Thursday, September 4 through Wednesday, September 10.
The museum is located on the National Mall at Constitution Avenue, N.W., between 12th and 14th Streets, Washington, D.C.
Museum entrances are located on Constitution Avenue on the first floor and Madison Drive (National Mall) on the second floor.
There may be a short wait to enter the building.
Groups of 10 or more can email NMAHGroupInfo@si.edu with the name and size of your group, planned visit date, and estimated arrival time.
Please note that this is not a tour reservation, and you are welcome to visit at any time during public visiting hours without registering.
Masks are not required to visit the museum.
Visitors may choose to wear a mask during their visit.
